我开心的一天(My Happy Day): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
I often play tennis after class.
My friend Anna is very kind.
We talk about science a lot.
The gift box is big and clean.
We often go to the zoo together.
column3: 我们经常一起去动物园。
